name: matthews-agentic-plugins
description: 20 Claude Code plugins for agentic workflows, organized around Boris Cherny's five stages of AI adoption: verification, permissions, context, orchestration, and governance.

plugins.name: verify-before-review
plugins.description: Run tests, lint, and build as a self-verification loop before you review changes.

plugins.name: code-review-agent
plugins.description: An automated code-review subagent for your working diff, plus a /code-review command.

plugins.name: security-review-agent
plugins.description: A security-review subagent that scans changes for common vulnerabilities.

plugins.name: test-guardian
plugins.description: Automatically run the test suite after edits and surface failures.

plugins.name: e2e-verifier
plugins.description: A checklist-driven skill for end-to-end verification before handing work to a human.

plugins.name: permission-optimizer
plugins.description: Analyze denied tool calls and propose a safe allowlist to reduce permission prompts.

plugins.name: auto-mode-setup
plugins.description: Configure auto mode and pre-approve safe bash and MCP commands in settings.

plugins.name: plan-mode-helper
plugins.description: Draft and refine an implementation plan before executing (plan-first workflow).

plugins.name: skills-connector
plugins.description: Scaffold, list, and wire up Claude Code skills — connect new skills into your workflow.

plugins.name: claude-md-manager
plugins.description: Scaffold and lint CLAUDE.md project standards and memory files.

plugins.name: context-puller
plugins.description: Pull context from READMEs, docs, and wikis into Claude's memory for a task.

plugins.name: repo-onboarder
plugins.description: Generate an onboarding guide for a repository via an exploring subagent.

plugins.name: agent-kickoff
plugins.description: Kick off subagents to work tasks in parallel (agent-to-agent orchestration).

plugins.name: worktree-isolation
plugins.description: Run a task on an isolated git worktree to avoid merge conflicts between agents.

plugins.name: loop-runner
plugins.description: Turn a task into a recurring routine using the /loop taxonomy.

plugins.name: parallel-lanes
plugins.description: Fan out independent work across multiple parallel lanes.

plugins.name: routine-scheduler
plugins.description: Define scheduled routines that run on a cadence.

plugins.name: cost-controller
plugins.description: Apply a model-selection policy — cheaper models for bulk work, frontier for judgment.

plugins.name: token-budget-tracker
plugins.description: Track token usage per session and warn as you approach a budget.

plugins.name: otel-governance
plugins.description: Enable OpenTelemetry export and spend caps for team governance.

plugins.name: secret-scanner
plugins.description: Detect likely secrets (API keys, tokens, private keys) in the working diff before they're shared.

plugins.name: dependency-auditor
plugins.description: Audit dependencies for known vulnerabilities using the ecosystem's native tools.

plugins.name: license-compliance
plugins.description: Inventory dependency licenses and flag ones outside your allowlist (SPDX).

plugins.name: sbom-generator
plugins.description: Generate a CycloneDX/SPDX Software Bill of Materials for your project.

plugins.name: access-review
plugins.description: A read-only subagent that reviews IAM/RBAC/permission changes for over-broad grants and escalation.

plugins.name: pr-governance
plugins.description: Enforce enterprise PR standards: description, linked ticket, size, tests, no unrelated changes.

plugins.name: conventional-commits
plugins.description: Format and enforce Conventional Commits with a validation hook.

plugins.name: adr-manager
plugins.description: Create and manage Architecture Decision Records (MADR-style).
